A1.justification: Both 24-page PDFs describe the same EvolvR study and include corresponding Appendices A-D. The text, equations, tables, figures and appendix displays support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original evaluator benchmarks, ablations and human evaluations of generated stories in Section 4, plus robustness and annotator-agreement analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including the evaluator comparisons, generation experiments and supplementary analyses.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain the same multi-persona CoT synthesis, filtering/refinement pipeline, pairwise evaluator and evaluator-guided GRPO procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use StoryER-Scale and HANNA for evaluator training/testing, OpenMEVA for zero-shot evaluation, and HANNA for story-generation experiments. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1-3 and the generation comparisons: proprietary models, open-source evaluators, Coke, base models, ablated variants, SFT and Point-RM GRPO are retained.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C retain the same splits, metrics, model configurations, comparison-pair sampling, position swapping and four-expert human-evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: The component ablations, pair-count sensitivity tests, positional-bias analysis, reference-pairing comparison and generated-story case studies are unchanged, including Tables 6, 10, 11 and 13 and Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both retain score standard deviations in Table 12 and inter-expert correlation analyses in Tables 14-15. No run/seed information or uncertainty-reporting procedure is added or revised.

E6.justification: Corresponding main-text and appendix results match. For example, Table 1 retains EvolvR Pearson correlations of 0.6774 on StoryER and 0.6155 on HANNA, while Table 5 retains its generation win rate of 0.6436 against the base model.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1-14 are unchanged, including the filtering criteria, confidence calculation and reward objectives. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: self-evolving pairwise reasoning, claimed state-of-the-art evaluation across three benchmarks and improved generation using EvolvR as a reward model.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of pairwise reliability, GRPO reward hacking and reference choice, alongside discussion of subjective human judgments and decreased generation coherence. No substantive explanation or limitation changes.

D1.justification: The documented synthesis/filtering counts, hardware and software specifications, evaluation implementation details, appendix prompt templates and code-availability statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography and related-work discussion are unchanged. EvolvR's positioning relative to existing evaluators, reasoning methods and story-generation approaches remains the same.

P1.justification: Page 1 revises the author list and affiliation assignments, replaces Chen Zhang with Feng Xiao as corresponding author, and updates the version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author/affiliation block is reformatted, with affiliation and contribution-note lines regrouped. Figures 1-16 and Tables 1-15 retain their content, structure and placement, including the appendix prompt and story displays.

improvement.justification: v2 retains the same method, experimental evidence, interpretations and reproducibility information throughout the main text and appendices. The authorship, affiliation and minor presentation edits do not materially change the paper's clarity, evidential support or scientific quality.
